# Design Tokens

FidoUI uses CSS custom properties as design tokens, defined in `fido-ui-theme.css`. Values are synced from Figma. **Primary is the default theme** — no `data-fido-ui-theme` attribute (or `data-fido-ui-theme="primary"`) gets the base tokens as-is. **FidoAlert** layers brand overrides on top via `[data-fido-ui-theme='fidoAlert']`.

Use the **Theme** toolbar above to switch between Primary and FidoAlert — the showcase below reads the live computed CSS variable values, so it always reflects exactly what's shipping for the selected theme.

## Responsive tokens

Canonical names (e.g. `--spacing-fido-ui-md`, `--radius-fido-ui-lg`) use **Desktop** values. Tablet and mobile are available as suffixed variables:

- `--spacing-fido-ui-md-tablet` / `--spacing-fido-ui-md-mobile`
- Same pattern for `radius`, `size`, `font-size`, and block layout tokens.

Suggested breakpoints when reading suffixed vars in custom CSS: tablet `max-width: 1023px`, mobile `max-width: 767px`.

## Typography

The typography scale comes straight from the Figma token file (`Font.Family` + `Font.Sizes`) and is the **only** size scale:

- **Headings:** `text-fido-ui-h1` … `text-fido-ui-h5`
- **Paragraphs:** `text-fido-ui-p1` … `text-fido-ui-p5`
- **Families:** `font-fido-ui-heading`, `font-fido-ui-paragraph`, `font-fido-ui-label` (all Archivo today, but the roles are distinct variables so product themes can diverge later)

There is no `xs`/`sm`/`md`/`base`/`lg`/`xl` text scale — the former legacy scale was removed in favor of the semantic H/P scale (`xs`→`p5`, `sm`→`p4`, `md`→`p3`, `base`→`p2`, `lg`/`xl`→`p1`).

Canonical utilities use the **desktop** value. Tablet/mobile sizes ship as opt-in variables (`--font-size-fido-ui-h1-tablet`, `--font-size-fido-ui-p3-mobile`, …) — the library never applies them automatically; apply them in product CSS via the breakpoints above.

Line-height tokens (`leading-fido-ui-tight` 1.25, `leading-fido-ui-normal` 1.4, `leading-fido-ui-relaxed` 1.6) are **FidoUI conventions**, not Figma-synced — the token file does not define line heights yet.

```css
@import "tailwindcss";
@import "@petscreeninginc/fido-ui/tokens/theme.css";
@import "@petscreeninginc/fido-ui/tokens/themes/fido-alert.css";
```

```html
<html data-fido-ui-theme="fidoAlert">
```

See the **Theming & Customization** page for the full breakdown of product themes and token overrides.

---

## Overriding Tokens

Override CSS custom properties to customize the theme:

```css
/* your-overrides.css — load AFTER fido-ui-theme.css */
@theme {
  --color-fido-ui-primary-500: #8b5cf6;
  --color-fido-ui-primary-700: #6d28d9;
}
```

## Accessing Tokens in JavaScript

```ts
import { colors } from '@petscreeninginc/fido-ui/tokens';

console.log(colors.primary[500]); // Primary default value
```

`colors.ts` exports **primitive palettes only** (Primary values). Semantic colors, strokes, sizes, blocks, and responsive values are defined in `fido-ui-theme.css`; per-theme overrides live in `tokens/themes/*.css` and the registry at `src/tokens/themes.ts`.
